plugin.name: SKDMoonlight
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Finds the good moonlight room during the SKD taunt phase

trigger.match: ^.*Shimmering moonlight floats through the cracks in the ceiling to grace the floor\.$
^You shout ridiculous insults at the Sea King, whose face reddens with rage\.$
^From somewhere nearby, you hear (.*?) shout ridiculous insults at the Sea King\.|^(.*?) shouts ridiculous insults at the Sea King, whose face reddens with rage\.$
^The Sea King leaps away, clinging to the ceiling overhead\.$
^The Sea King drops back down to the floor and glances over the wreckage\.$
^His eyes begin to glow red, and you feel your soul start to pull away from your body\.$

muclient.script:
dofile(GetInfo(60) .. "aardwolf_colors.lua") require "gmcphelper"
-- cnote: echoes @-colour-coded text locally, in colour function cnote(s) AnsiNote(stylesToANSI(ColoursToStyles(s))) end
-- gtell: sends a colour-coded message to the group, no local echo function gtell(msg) SendNoEcho("gtell " .. msg) end
-- =========================================================== -- Moonlight locator (from Kanaye's SKDAssistant idea) -- During the taunt phase there are moonlit arena rooms: bad ones -- (shimmering line, then a RANDOM-chance "moonlight caresses your -- cheek" + pain on entry) and the good one (shimmering, never a -- caress). Standing detection: mark bad rooms off the caress line; -- once 2 bad rooms are known, the next moonlit room is good by -- elimination and is announced. The mlf hunt auto-walks and tests. -- ===========================================================
-- The 12 SKD arena rooms: compass label + adjacent tanking spots. -- GMCP room numbers arrive as strings, so keys are strings. local ml_rooms = { ["28379"] = { label = "NA", tank = {"N"} }, ["28380"] = { label = "N", tank = {"NA", "NW", "NE"} }, ["28381"] = { label = "NW", tank = {"N", "W"} }, ["28383"] = { label = "W", tank = {"NW", "WA", "SW"} }, ["28384"] = { label = "WA", tank = {"W"} }, ["28387"] = { label = "SW", tank = {"W", "S"} }, ["28389"] = { label = "S", tank = {"SA", "SW", "SE"} }, ["28390"] = { label = "SA", tank = {"S"} }, ["28388"] = { label = "SE", tank = {"S", "E"} }, ["28385"] = { label = "E", tank = {"EA", "SE", "NE"} }, ["28386"] = { label = "EA", tank = {"E"} }, ["28382"] = { label = "NE", tank = {"N", "E"} }, }
-- Arena geography, read straight off the mapper database (NOT inferred -- from the tank lists above): an eight room ring - N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, -- W, NW - with one dead-end alcove hanging off each of N, E, S and W. -- Each entry is the single direction that takes you from this room into -- that one. This is what lets the hunt route AROUND a room already known -- to be bad moonlight instead of walking straight through it. local arena_exits = { ["28379"] = { {dir = "s", to = "28380"} }, -- NA ["28380"] = { {dir = "e", to = "28382"}, {dir = "w", to = "28381"}, {dir = "n", to = "28379"} }, -- N ["28381"] = { {dir = "e", to = "28380"}, {dir = "s", to = "28383"} }, -- NW ["28382"] = { {dir = "w", to = "28380"}, {dir = "s", to = "28385"} }, -- NE ["28383"] = { {dir = "n", to = "28381"}, {dir = "s", to = "28387"}, {dir = "w", to = "28384"} }, -- W ["28384"] = { {dir = "e", to = "28383"} }, -- WA ["28385"] = { {dir = "n", to = "28382"}, {dir = "s", to = "28388"}, {dir = "e", to = "28386"} }, -- E ["28386"] = { {dir = "w", to = "28385"} }, -- EA ["28387"] = { {dir = "n", to = "28383"}, {dir = "e", to = "28389"} }, -- SW ["28388"] = { {dir = "n", to = "28385"}, {dir = "w", to = "28389"} }, -- SE ["28389"] = { {dir = "e", to = "28388"}, {dir = "w", to = "28387"}, {dir = "s", to = "28390"} }, -- S ["28390"] = { {dir = "n", to = "28389"} }, -- SA }
local ml_bad = {} -- set: room -> true for known bad-moonlight rooms local ml_bad_queue = {} -- same rooms in sighting order (max 2 kept) local ml_announced = nil -- room called as good this cycle, if any
-- A circuit of the arena: N, NE, E, EA, SE, S, SA, SW, W, WA, NW, NA local hunt_order = { "28380", "28382", "28385", "28386", "28388", "28389", "28390", "28387", "28383", "28384", "28381", "28379", } local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" local hunting = false local hunt_route = {} local hunt_index = 0 local hunt_laps = 0 -- completed circuits this hunt local HUNT_MAX_LAPS = 3 -- The caress is a RANDOM chance each entry (instant when it fires), so a -- single entry can never prove a room good - we bounce in/out and only -- call a room good after HUNT_BOUNCES clean entries with no caress. local HUNT_BOUNCES = 5 -- clean in/out entries to call a moonlit room good (adjustable: mlf bounces N) -- Hunt method: "sweep" (circle until 2 bad rooms seen, third is good) or -- "bounce" (the old in/out testing). Toggle with: mlf method local hunt_method = "sweep" local SWEEP_MAX_LAPS = 10 -- sweep never re-tests, so allow more laps local SWEEP_MAX_VISITS = 60 -- focused sweep: cap on room visits once the 3 moonlit rooms are known local hunt_visits = 0 local hunt_moonlit = {} -- sweep: set of rooms seen moonlit this hunt local HUNT_PEEK = 0.25 -- short window after each entry to catch the (instant) caress local HUNT_MOVE_TIMEOUT = 6 -- seconds before a stuck move aborts the hunt -- Navigation is strictly one move at a time: we only ever send the next -- step once room.info confirms arrival at hunt_await. Steps come from -- arena_exits, so a walk can be routed round known bad moonlight. local hunt_await = nil -- room number we are waiting to arrive at (the next STEP) local hunt_mode = nil -- "walk" | "bounce_out" | "bounce_in" | "goto_good" local hunt_dest = nil -- room this walk is actually heading for local hunt_hops = {} -- the steps still to take to reach hunt_dest local hunt_move_tok = 0 -- token so a stale watchdog can't fire local eval_room = nil -- room we've arrived in and are judging local eval_shimmer = false -- shimmer (moonlit) seen in eval_room local eval_caressed = false -- caress (bad moonlight) seen in eval_room local test_room = nil -- moonlit room currently being bounce-tested local test_partner = nil -- adjacent room we bounce out to local test_count = 0 -- clean entries so far this test local hunt_alas = 0 -- consecutive blocked-move messages
local function hunt_note(msg) cnote("@x099[@x045SKDMoonlight@x099]@w " .. msg) end
function hunt_abort(reason) if hunting then hunting = false eval_room = nil hunt_await = nil hunt_mode = nil hunt_hops = {} test_room = nil hunt_note(reason .. " - hunt @x196aborted@w. Type @x048mlf@w to go again.") end end
function ml_reset(name, line, wildcards) ml_bad = {} ml_bad_queue = {} ml_announced = nil hunt_abort("Moonlight moved") end
local function ml_message(details) local t = details.tank local spots if #t == 1 then spots = "@x048" .. t[1] elseif #t == 2 then spots = "@x048" .. t[1] .. "@w or @x048" .. t[2] else spots = "@x048" .. table.concat(t, "@w, @x048", 1, #t - 1) .. "@w or @x048" .. t[#t] end return "@x099(@x045SKD@x099)@w @x048GOOD MOONLIGHT@w at @x045" .. details.label .. "@w! Tank the Sea King at " .. spots .. "@w" end
-- Caress line seen: this room is bad moonlight. Records the fact only - -- it NEVER drives navigation (the hunt state machine owns movement). -- While hunting it just raises eval_caressed for the room we're judging. function bad_ml_line(name, line, wildcards) local room_num = gmcp("room.info.num") if not room_num or not ml_rooms[room_num] then return end if hunting and room_num == eval_room then eval_caressed = true end if ml_announced == room_num then gtell("@x099(@x045SKD@x099)@w Scratch that - @x045" .. ml_rooms[room_num].label .. "@w is @x196BAD@w moonlight, keep hunting!") ml_announced = nil end if not ml_bad[room_num] then ml_bad[room_num] = true table.insert(ml_bad_queue, room_num) if #ml_bad_queue > 2 then ml_bad[table.remove(ml_bad_queue, 1)] = nil -- a bad moonlight moved; forget the oldest end end end
-- Shimmering line seen: once 2 bad rooms are known, any other room -- showing it is the good one by elimination - call it immediately. -- During a hunt, the hunt logic owns the decision instead. function good_ml_line(name, line, wildcards) if hunting then -- shimmer = this room is moonlit; note it for the room we're judging local here = gmcp("room.info.num") if eval_room and here == eval_room then eval_shimmer = true end -- sweep: remember EVERY moonlit room we see, including ones we are only -- passing through on the way to the next stop, so it is already known -- when the 2 bad rooms turn up. if hunt_method == "sweep" and here and ml_rooms[here] then hunt_moonlit[here] = true end return end if ml_announced or #ml_bad_queue < 2 then return end local room_num = gmcp("room.info.num") if not room_num or not ml_rooms[room_num] then return end if ml_bad[room_num] then return end ml_announced = room_num gtell(ml_message(ml_rooms[room_num])) end
function cmd_ml(name, line, wildcards) local room_num = gmcp("room.info.num") local details = room_num and ml_rooms[room_num] if not details then cnote("@x099[@x045SKDMoonlight@x099]@w Not in the SKD arena - stand in the good moonlight room and try @x048ml@w again.") return end SendNoEcho("gtell " .. ml_message(details)) end
-- =========================================================== -- Moonlight hunt: mlf walks the arena. The caress is a RANDOM chance -- per entry (instant when it fires), so one clean entry proves nothing. -- Two methods (mlf method): -- SWEEP (default): never re-tests. Keep circling until 2 bad rooms -- have caressed, then the remaining moonlit room is GOOD by -- elimination. Up to 10 laps. -- BOUNCE: in each moonlit room, bounce in and out - the way a person -- does it. Caress = BAD, move on; HUNT_BOUNCES clean entries with -- no caress = GOOD. Up to 3 laps. -- Either way, once 2 bad rooms are known the next moonlit room is GOOD -- (no more testing), non-moonlit rooms are skipped after a quick glance, -- and navigation is strictly one move at a time. -- ===========================================================
-- ---- Pain-aware routing --------------------------------------------- -- A known bad moonlight room hurts EVERY time you set foot in it, so we -- path over arena_exits ourselves instead of letting the mapper draw the -- shortest line. Known bad rooms are treated as walls, and because the -- eight main rooms form a ring there is nearly always a way round: we -- loop the other way rather than take another caress. Only when every -- route crosses a bad room (an alcove sitting behind one, say) do we -- walk through it.
-- Shortest list of steps from `from` to `to`. With avoid_bad set, known -- bad rooms are not walked THROUGH - the destination itself is always -- allowed. Returns a list of room numbers, each one move from the last, -- or nil if there is no such route. local function arena_bfs(from, to, avoid_bad) if from == to then return {} end local prev, queue, head = {}, {from}, 1 local seen = {[from] = true} while head <= #queue do local cur = queue[head] head = head + 1 for _, ex in ipairs(arena_exits[cur] or {}) do local nxt = ex.to if nxt == to then local path, p = {to}, cur while p ~= from do table.insert(path, 1, p) p = prev[p] end return path end if not seen[nxt] and not (avoid_bad and ml_bad[nxt]) then seen[nxt] = true prev[nxt] = cur table.insert(queue, nxt) end end end return nil end
-- The route to walk: the detour round the bad rooms when one exists, -- otherwise the direct line. Also returns whether the route is clean -- (false = forced to cross a bad room) and the direct distance, so the -- caller can say when it is taking the long way. local function arena_route(from, to) if not arena_exits[from] or not arena_exits[to] then return nil end local direct = arena_bfs(from, to, false) local direct_len = direct and #direct or 0 local clean = arena_bfs(from, to, true) if clean then return clean, true, direct_len end return direct, false, direct_len end
-- The direction from `from` into `to`, or nil if they are not neighbours. local function arena_dir(from, to) for _, ex in ipairs(arena_exits[from] or {}) do if ex.to == to then return ex.dir end end return nil end
-- Send exactly one move and arm the watchdog. Nothing else may move -- until room.info confirms arrival at hunt_await. A single step is sent -- as a bare direction (silent and instant); only if we somehow do not -- know the exit does the mapper get asked to path it. local function hunt_hop() local nxt = table.remove(hunt_hops, 1) hunt_await = nxt hunt_move_tok = hunt_move_tok + 1 local tok = hunt_move_tok DoAfterSpecial(HUNT_MOVE_TIMEOUT, "hunt_move_watchdog(" .. tok .. ")", 12) local here = gmcp("room.info.num") local dir = here and arena_dir(here, nxt) if dir then Send(dir) else Execute("mapper goto " .. nxt) end end
-- Plan the walk from where we stand to `room` and take the first step. -- Called again at every step along the way, so a bad room discovered -- mid-walk re-routes whatever is left of it. local function hunt_route_to(room, announce) local here = gmcp("room.info.num") local hops, clean, direct = nil, true, 0 if here then hops, clean, direct = arena_route(here, room) end local label = (ml_rooms[room] and ml_rooms[room].label) or room if hops then hunt_hops = hops else hunt_hops = {room} -- unknown ground: hand it to the mapper end if announce and hops and #hops > 0 then if not clean then hunt_note("No way round the bad moonlight - crossing it to reach @x045" .. label .. "@w.") elseif direct > 0 and #hops > direct then hunt_note("Looping round the bad moonlight to @x045" .. label .. "@w (" .. #hops .. " rooms the long way, not " .. direct .. ").") end end if #hunt_hops == 0 then -- already standing in the target room: judge it where we are hunt_await = room DoAfterSpecial(0.1, "hunt_arrived(" .. string.format("%q", room) .. ")", 12) return end hunt_hop() end
-- Walk to `room` in `mode`, keeping out of known bad moonlight on the way. function hunt_go(room, mode) hunt_mode = mode hunt_dest = room hunt_route_to(room, true) end
-- If a move never lands (mapper confused, blocked, etc.) abort cleanly -- instead of letting the hunt wander into walls. function hunt_move_watchdog(tok) if not hunting then return end if hunt_await ~= nil and tok == hunt_move_tok then hunt_abort("Navigation stalled (couldn't reach the next room)") end end
-- Move on to the next circuit room (ends any test in progress). function hunt_next() test_room = nil test_partner = nil test_count = 0 -- Step along the circuit, skipping any room already known to be bad -- moonlight: it never needs visiting again this cycle, and walking in -- would only buy another caress. for _ = 1, #hunt_route do hunt_index = hunt_index + 1 if hunt_index > #hunt_route then -- circuit done without finding the good room - go around again hunt_laps = hunt_laps + 1 local max_laps = (hunt_method == "sweep") and SWEEP_MAX_LAPS or HUNT_MAX_LAPS if hunt_laps >= max_laps then hunting = false hunt_await = nil hunt_mode = nil hunt_note("Walked the arena " .. max_laps .. " times without finding good moonlight - giving up. @x048mlf@w to retry.") return end if hunt_method == "sweep" then hunt_note("Lap done, only " .. #ml_bad_queue .. " bad room(s) found so far - going around again.") else hunt_note("Lap done, no good moonlight found yet - going around again.") end hunt_index = 1 end if not ml_bad[hunt_route[hunt_index]] then hunt_go(hunt_route[hunt_index], "walk") return end end hunt_go(hunt_route[hunt_index], "walk") -- every room marked bad (cannot happen with 2 marks) end
-- Pick a neighbouring room to bounce out to (real exits, not the tank -- list), preferring one not already known bad so we take less avoidable -- pain. local function pick_partner(room) local exits = arena_exits[room] or {} for _, ex in ipairs(exits) do if not ml_bad[ex.to] then return ex.to end end return exits[1] and exits[1].to end
function cmd_mlhunt(name, line, wildcards) if hunting then hunt_note("Hunt already running - @x048mlf stop@w to abort.") return end local room_num = gmcp("room.info.num") if not room_num or not ml_rooms[room_num] then hunt_note("You need to be inside the SKD arena to start a moonlight hunt.") return end local start_pos = 1 for i, r in ipairs(hunt_order) do if r == room_num then start_pos = i break end end hunt_route = {} for i = 1, #hunt_order do table.insert(hunt_route, hunt_order[((start_pos - 1 + i) % #hunt_order) + 1]) end hunting = true hunt_index = 0 hunt_laps = 0 hunt_await = nil hunt_mode = nil hunt_hops = {} hunt_dest = nil eval_room = nil eval_shimmer = false eval_caressed = false test_room = nil test_partner = nil test_count = 0 hunt_moonlit = {} hunt_visits = 0 hunt_alas = 0 hunt_note("Moonlight hunt started (" .. hunt_method .. " method) - walking the arena. @x048mlf stop@w to abort.") hunt_next() end
-- A blocked move during a hunt: re-path from where we actually are. -- Give up after a few in a row rather than pinball off walls. function hunt_alas_line(name, line, wildcards) if not hunting or not hunt_await then return end hunt_alas = hunt_alas + 1 if hunt_alas > 3 then hunt_abort("Navigation blocked (kept hitting walls)") return end local here = gmcp("room.info.num") local dir = here and arena_dir(here, hunt_await) if dir then Send(dir) else Execute("mapper goto " .. hunt_await) end end
function cmd_mlhunt_stop(name, line, wildcards) if hunting then hunting = false eval_room = nil hunt_await = nil hunt_mode = nil hunt_hops = {} test_room = nil hunt_note("Moonlight hunt @x196aborted@w.") else hunt_note("No hunt running.") end end
-- Declare a room good and stop the hunt. `reason` explains how we knew. local function hunt_stop_good(room, reason) test_room = nil hunting = false hunt_await = nil hunt_mode = nil hunt_hops = {} ml_announced = room gtell(ml_message(ml_rooms[room])) hunt_note(reason .. " - @x045" .. ml_rooms[room].label .. "@w is @x048good moonlight@w, stopping here.") end
-- Sweep helper: the moonlit rooms we've seen that are not known bad. local function sweep_candidates() local c = {} for _, r in ipairs(hunt_order) do if hunt_moonlit[r] and not ml_bad[r] then table.insert(c, r) end end return c end
-- Sweep method: never re-test. Caress = bad. Once 2 bad rooms are known the -- remaining moonlit room is good - go straight to it if we already saw it, -- otherwise keep circling and the next non-bad moonlit room is it. -- If both bad rooms are known and we have already seen the third moonlit -- room (even just walking through it), head straight there. local function sweep_resolve() if #ml_bad_queue < 2 then return false end for _, r in ipairs(sweep_candidates()) do if r ~= eval_room then hunt_note("Both bad rooms known - heading to the room passed earlier, @x045" .. ml_rooms[r].label .. "@w.") hunt_go(r, "goto_good") return true end end return false end
-- Sweep advance: until all 3 moonlit rooms are known, keep circling the whole -- arena. Once they are, only the moonlit rooms NOT yet known bad matter, so -- hop between just those (a few moves) instead of walking all 12 rooms again. local function sweep_advance() local seen = 0 for _ in pairs(hunt_moonlit) do seen = seen + 1 end if seen >= 3 then local c = sweep_candidates() if #c >= 1 then hunt_visits = hunt_visits + 1 if hunt_visits > SWEEP_MAX_VISITS then hunting = false hunt_await = nil hunt_mode = nil hunt_note("Checked the moonlit rooms " .. SWEEP_MAX_VISITS .. " times without finding the second bad one - giving up. @x048mlf@w to retry.") return end local function pos(r) for i, rr in ipairs(hunt_order) do if rr == r then return i end end return 0 end local cur = pos(eval_room) local pick = c[1] for _, r in ipairs(c) do if pos(r) > cur then pick = r break end end if pick ~= eval_room then hunt_go(pick, "walk") return end end end hunt_next() end
local function hunt_judge_sweep() -- every shimmer seen is a moonlit room, bad (caress) or not if eval_shimmer or eval_caressed then hunt_moonlit[eval_room] = true end if hunt_mode ~= "goto_good" and sweep_resolve() then return end if eval_caressed then hunt_note("@x045" .. ml_rooms[eval_room].label .. "@w caressed - @x196BAD@w (" .. #ml_bad_queue .. "/2 known).") if hunt_mode == "goto_good" then hunt_note("The room we expected to be good caressed - resuming the sweep.") end if #ml_bad_queue >= 2 then local c = sweep_candidates() if #c >= 1 then hunt_note("Both bad rooms known - heading to @x045" .. ml_rooms[c[1]].label .. "@w.") hunt_go(c[1], "goto_good") return end end sweep_advance() return end if hunt_mode == "goto_good" then hunt_stop_good(eval_room, "Both bad moonlights found") return end if not eval_shimmer then sweep_advance() return end if ml_bad[eval_room] then sweep_advance() return end hunt_moonlit[eval_room] = true if #ml_bad_queue >= 2 then hunt_stop_good(eval_room, "Both bad moonlights found") return end hunt_note("@x045" .. ml_rooms[eval_room].label .. "@w is moonlit, no caress - noted, moving on.") sweep_advance() end
-- HUNT_PEEK after each entry, judge what we saw. Sweep has its own judge -- above; the rest of this function is the bounce method: -- caress -> BAD, move on -- moonlit, walk-in -> if the 2 bad rooms are already known, this other -- moonlit room is GOOD by elimination (no bouncing); -- otherwise start bouncing it -- moonlit, bounced -> another clean entry; after HUNT_BOUNCES of them -- with no caress, call it GOOD function hunt_judge() if not hunting or not eval_room then return end if hunt_method == "sweep" then hunt_judge_sweep() return end -- ---- bounce method ---- if eval_caressed then local bad = eval_room hunt_note("@x045" .. ml_rooms[bad].label .. "@w caressed - @x196BAD@w, moving on.") hunt_next() return end if hunt_mode == "walk" then if not eval_shimmer then hunt_next() -- not moonlit, skip it return end if ml_bad[eval_room] then hunt_next() -- already known bad, no need to test again return end if #ml_bad_queue >= 2 then -- both bad moonlights are known; this other moonlit room is the good one hunt_stop_good(eval_room, "Both bad moonlights found") return end -- fewer than 2 bads known: bounce-test this moonlit room test_room = eval_room test_partner = pick_partner(eval_room) test_count = 1 hunt_note("@x045" .. ml_rooms[test_room].label .. "@w is moonlit - checking in/out...") else test_count = test_count + 1 end if test_count >= HUNT_BOUNCES then hunt_stop_good(test_room, "No caress in " .. HUNT_BOUNCES .. " entries") else hunt_go(test_partner, "bounce_out") end end
-- Arrival at the room we were waiting for. A stop part way along a route -- just takes the next step (and re-paths, in case a bad room turned up -- while we were walking); only arrival at hunt_dest gets judged. function hunt_arrived(room_num) if not hunting then return end if not room_num or room_num ~= hunt_await then return end -- passing through / not there yet hunt_await = nil hunt_alas = 0 if #hunt_hops > 0 then hunt_route_to(hunt_dest, false) return end if hunt_mode == "bounce_out" then hunt_go(test_room, "bounce_in") -- at the partner, straight back in return end -- walk, goto_good or bounce_in arrival: judge this entry once the lines have printed eval_room = room_num eval_shimmer = false eval_caressed = false DoAfterSpecial(HUNT_PEEK, "hunt_judge()", 12) end
-- GMCP drives the hunt: room.info = arrival (only acted on when it -- matches the room we're waiting for), char.status = combat check. function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if id ~= GMCP_ID then return end if not hunting then return end if text == "char.status" then if gmcp("char.status.state") == "8" then hunt_abort("You're being attacked") end return end if text ~= "room.info" then return end hunt_arrived(gmcp("room.info.num")) end
-- Bounce count and hunt method are user-tunable and saved next to the -- plugin so they survive reinstalls (SetVariable would not). local BOUNCES_FILE = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 20) .. "SKDMoonlight_config.txt"
function save_bounces() local f = io.open(BOUNCES_FILE, "w") if f then f:write("bounces=" .. HUNT_BOUNCES .. "\n") f:write("method=" .. hunt_method .. "\n") f:close() end end
function load_bounces() local f = io.open(BOUNCES_FILE, "r") if f then for l in f:lines() do local n = l:match("^bounces=(%d+)") if n then HUNT_BOUNCES = tonumber(n) end local m = l:match("^method=(%a+)") if m == "sweep" or m == "bounce" then hunt_method = m end end f:close() end end
function cmd_set_method(name, line, wildcards) local m = wildcards and wildcards[1] if m == "sweep" or m == "bounce" then hunt_method = m else hunt_method = (hunt_method == "sweep") and "bounce" or "sweep" end save_bounces() if hunt_method == "sweep" then cnote("@x099[@x045SKDMoonlight@x099]@w Moonlight hunt method: @x048SWEEP@w - circle the arena until 2 bad rooms are seen, then the third is good.") else cnote("@x099[@x045SKDMoonlight@x099]@w Moonlight hunt method: @x048BOUNCE@w - bounce in/out of each moonlit room (@x048" .. HUNT_BOUNCES .. "@w clean entries = good).") end if hunting then cnote("@x099[@x045SKDMoonlight@x099]@w Takes effect on the next @x048mlf@w (@x048mlf stop@w first to restart now).") end end
function cmd_set_bounces(name, line, wildcards) local n = tonumber(wildcards[1]) if not n or n < 1 or n > 99 then cnote("@x099[@x045SKDMoonlight@x099]@w Bounce count must be @x0481-99@w. Currently @x048" .. HUNT_BOUNCES .. "@w.") return end HUNT_BOUNCES = n save_bounces() cnote("@x099[@x045SKDMoonlight@x099]@w Moonlight bounce count set to @x048" .. HUNT_BOUNCES .. "@w (entries with no caress before a room is called good).") end
function cmd_help(name, line, wildcards) cnote("") cnote("@x099===== @x045SKD Moonlight Finder@x099 =====@w") cnote("@wFinds the good moonlight room during the SKD taunt phase.") cnote("@wStanding still: once @x0482@w bad rooms are known it auto-gtells the good one when") cnote("@wyou're in it. Or use @x048mlf@w to auto-walk the arena and find it hands-free.") cnote("") cnote("@wCommands:@w") cnote(" @Wml@w gtell good moonlight from the room you're standing in") cnote(" @Wmlf@w auto-walk the arena (method now: @x048" .. string.upper(hunt_method) ..
